# hippius-drive

> Python SDK and CLI for Hippius Drive. Files are encrypted on the machine that holds the recovery phrase. The server stores ciphertext.

Part of the Hippius docs for agents. Start at https://docs.hippius.com/llms.txt

## What it is and what it does

A scriptable client for the same Drive a person sees in the console, the desktop app, and the Android app. It is alpha. The sync engine and recovery bindings are not in this version.

Drive is not S3. A file put through this SDK does not appear in an S3 bucket.

## How to install

The README says `pip install hippius-drive`. That name is not on PyPI. Install from this repository:

```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/thenervelab/hippius-drive-sdk"
```

Python 3.10 to 3.13.

## How to sign in

The caller needs three things that belong together:

- An API token from https://console.hippius.com/dashboard/settings
- The account address that token belongs to
- The recovery phrase for the Drive

The phrase never leaves the user's machine. Do not ask them to paste it into chat. Read it from their environment if they have already stored it there.

```python
from pathlib import Path
from hippius_drive import Client, Identity

identity = Identity.from_master(master_phrase, "default", account_ss58=account)
with Client(token=token, identity=identity) as client:
    client.folders.register()
    client.files.put(Path("report.pdf"), "work/report.pdf")
```

A token and an address that do not belong together fail the first request with 403.

Paying and plans: https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/billing
What the console Drive UI does: https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/drive
